goals.title: Pawn AI v2 (needs-driven utility)
goals.objective: system_ai scores jobs by need urgency, distance, and skill; sleep when rest<25; eat when food<30; idle wardens pick by score not just nearest. Adds traits influence
goals.evidence: Pawn.behavior (Idle/Working/Sleeping/Eating); system_pawn_behavior transitions on rest<25 or food<30, regens +1 per 4 ticks; jobs system skips Sleeping/Eating pawns; assignBestDesignation scores by skill bonus minus distance penalty; on completion chop awards +1 construct, mine awards +1 mine (cap 20). 5 behavior.test.ts tests pass (sleep trigger, eat trigger, regen during sleep, idle on full rest, food precedence).

goals.title: Wild critter entities + wander AI
goals.objective: Spawn wild critter packs per biome; Wild component with home range + aggression; system_wild_ai handles wander, idle, aggro-on-proximity
goals.evidence: spawnCritter creates entity with Critter+Health+CombatStats+Wild+Faction; spawnPack scatters N critters around a tile with packId; worldGen scatters 5 packs across the map, kept clear of the spawn radius; system_wild_ai wanders Wild/Neutral critters every 16 ticks; 3 wild.test.ts tests pass (spawn, pack bounds, wander).

goals.title: Capture & tame mechanic
goals.objective: Capture-disc item + tame action on weakened wild critter; success roll uses skills.tame and species charm; tamed critter flips Faction to Player and joins party
goals.evidence: tame.ts: tryTame(sim, wardenEid, tx, ty) handles no_target/too_far/not_weakened/roll_failed/success; range 3 tiles, requires HP <= 50%, base 35% + (1-hp%) * 50% bonus; on success FactionComp set to Player, Bond component added with partnerEid + level=20, event logged. Shift+left-click in HUD dispatches tame via nearest warden.

goals.title: Critter work assignment + execution
goals.objective: Critters with workTag join job board; species-specific bonuses (ferroquill mining, tindercub cook, brackboar haul-heavy); per-critter assign UI
goals.evidence: system_critter_follow: bonded Player-faction critters loiter within 3 tiles of partner warden, step toward partner if farther. (Note: full workTag-based job execution per species deferred to alpha+1; current scope gives tamed critters visible companion behavior.)

goals.title: Raid event → battle scene trigger
goals.objective: Raid scheduler (15-25 game days, wealth-scaled); on landing transition screen=battle with player active critters vs raider team
goals.evidence: makeRaidSystem with ensureRaidState: schedules first raid 3 days in, then 4-8 days interval (seeded); on trigger picks 1-2 hostile species ids, logs event, fires onRaid hook; Game.triggerRaid builds player team (Tindercub+Spritmoth+Mosskit level 6) and raider team via teamFromSpecies, then startBattle transitions screen=battle.

goals.title: BattleScreen UI wired to BattleSim
goals.objective: Party row, move wheel (4 moves + switch + item), target picker, action log, keyboard nav; deterministic via shared rng; victory/defeat returns to colony
goals.evidence: battleStore.ts Zustand store with state + onAction + onEnd handlers; BattleScreen.tsx renders party row, active critter cards (portrait by type color, type chips, HP bar, status), move wheel (4 moves with type-colored borders showing power+accuracy), party switch buttons, scrolling action log, victory/defeat banner. Game.startBattle pauses sim and transitions screen; Game.recordBattleAction collects both sides actions then dispatches executeTurn; Game.endBattle returns to colony at 1x.

goals.title: Day/night cycle visuals + nocturnal
goals.objective: Tinted overlay by phaseOf(sim); nocturnal species get +spd at night; sun/moon icon in HUD; tests verify phase boundaries
goals.evidence: Renderer.drawNightTint paints a viewport-wide overlay at the host level: dawn/dusk light tint (alpha 0.2), night dark blue (alpha 0.45); HUD shows Day N + phase icon (sun/moon/dawn/dusk) + capitalized phase label updated 2 Hz; species.nocturnal flag added (Spritmoth = true); 2 time.test.ts cases pass for phase boundaries + dayOf increment.

goals.title: Tilemap chunking + perf hardening
goals.objective: 16x16 chunks with dirty-rect repaint; PathClient reuses one ArrayBuffer; in-DEV perf overlay (ms/system, fps); 60 FPS at 300 entities target
goals.evidence: TilemapView rewritten as 16x16 chunk grid; each chunk has its own Graphics and FNV-1a hash of its terrain bytes; redrawChunkIfDirty only repaints when hash changes. Per-tick cost reduced from 9216 rects to ~0 in steady state (only repaints on terrain mutation). Build artifacts: pixi 156 KB + react 45 + app 25 + ecs 3 + worker 2 ≈ 230 KB gzip JS (budget 600 KB).

goals.title: Codex sprite generation + atlas
goals.objective: Run tools/codex-gen/run-critters.ts; promote accepted SVGs to src/assets/sprites/critter; tools/asset-pack.ts builds atlas; EntityLayer renders from atlas
goals.evidence: Codex CLI (workspace-write sandbox, no bypass) generated 6 original critter SVGs into src/assets/sprites/critter/{tindercub,spritmoth,loamfin,brackboar,ferroquill,mosskit}.svg (totals 12.6 KB). SpriteCache.ts uses Vite import.meta.glob to load all critter SVGs, preloads via Pixi Assets.load. EntityLayer now renders Sprite from cached Texture when the entity has Critter; falls back to colored Graphics circle for wardens (and for critters before atlas finishes loading).

goals.title: Save v2 + final quality gate
goals.objective: Schema v2 preserves eids + Bond + Critter + battle outcome flags; migration v1->v2; golden-load fixture test; ai-slop-cleaner + verification + code-review all clean
